description: This file defines the FastRouteDispatcher class, which extends Slim Framework's routing capabilities using FastRoute. It manages dispatching HTTP requests to the appropriate route handlers, including fallback mechanisms for HEAD requests and method not allowed scenarios.

classes.name: FastRouteDispatcher
classes.description: A class that extends Slim Framework's GroupCountBased dispatcher to handle route dispatching, including fallback routes and allowed methods querying.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an HTTP request based on method and URI, with fallback handling for HEAD requests and other route fallback logic.

methods.name: routingResults
methods.description: Private method to find route results for a specific HTTP method and URI.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of HTTP methods allowed for a given URI.
